required_corrections: Stage B authorization remains false until independent validation passes.
Every gauge_truth array and pair identity file is hashed before and after computation.
The 525-cell barrier verifies the exact Cartesian membership, category, and frozen ledger of every atom.
A0 controls enter an explicit equal-or-lower exact-Ag-budget global dominance audit.
Overall summaries aggregate trajectories with equal weight.
Nested q4 diagnostics are recomputed from the q4 prefix rather than inherited from q8.

scientific_question: At the frozen 32x16x16 nine-view known straight-ray scale, do the v65-fixed standalone-q8 plus exact-adjoint plus exact-K1 and standalone-q4 plus exact-adjoint plus exact-K2 warm starts preserve or improve Zero-CGLS K4 field, gradient, and observation accuracy on five already-open public PoolFire morphology trajectories while reducing exact known-geometry A/A-transpose calls?
evidence_role: target-scale development compatibility and construction-cost gate after the independently validated v65 small-oracle PASS; it is not a fresh trajectory, learned operator, calibrated camera, curved-ray, real-BOST, generalization, resource-speed, novelty, or paper-success result

seen_before_freeze: The complete v65 small-grid formal and independent results were opened.
The v62 exact parallel factor resource result at 32x16x16 was opened.
Five PoolFire fit trajectories and their historical three-axis proxy pairs had already been opened in earlier C-route work.

The v66 implementation passed five small-grid unit tests: exact row reconstruction, exact full-rank factor action, adjoint identity, deterministic randomized low-rank quality, exact-call ledgers, and PoolFire xyz-to-zyx support mapping.
No target-scale v66 known-geometry factor, q4 or q8 target-scale action, PoolFire v66 observation, reconstruction, metric, aggregate, wall, or memory result had been computed.
fixed_after_freeze: The five trajectory IDs, five frame indices, three geometry scenarios, target geometry, q values, randomized-SVD parameters, detector-CR depth, exact-refinement depth, controls, metrics, thresholds, and aggregation rules cannot be changed after target-scale result access.
Factor construction is geometry-only and may not read a PoolFire truth, observation, residual, metric, or arm output.
No validation, stopping-validation, fresh, or untouched-test trajectory may be used to select rank, randomized-SVD parameters, geometry severity, control parameters, or stopping depth.

poolfire_truth_contract.axis_mapping: transpose each gauge_truth frame from (x,y,z) to (z,y,x)
poolfire_truth_contract.support: zero the one-voxel outer boundary used by every exact and factorized arm
poolfire_truth_contract.gauge_after_support: subtract the mean over support-positive voxels before multiplying by support
poolfire_truth_contract.normalization: no per-frame amplitude normalization; every arm sees the same transformed physical-density morphology
poolfire_truth_contract.observation_generation: noise-free y=Ag*x from the exact target known-geometry operator; historical three-axis 2072-vector pair observations are forbidden
poolfire_truth_contract.trajectory_independence_boundary: five frames from one trajectory are repeated temporal measures, not five independent generalization samples; aggregate and gates are trajectory-aware

factor_construction.family: standalone per-view per-component rearranged randomized SVD of Ag
factor_construction.rank_nesting: build rank 8 once; q4 is the immutable first-four prefix of the same randomized rank-8 factorization, matching the v65 nested exact-SVD family
setup_includes: randomized range finder and small SVD
setup_must_report: per-block retained energy and Frobenius residual

metric_contract.field_error: relative L2 to the support-projected PoolFire morphology truth
metric_contract.gradient_error: relative L2 of np.gradient in z,y,x with physical normalized-grid spacings and edge_order=2
metric_contract.observation_error: relative L2 residual under exact Ag
metric_contract.harm_ratio: (candidate absolute error + 1e-12*truth scale)/(Zero-K4 absolute error + 1e-12*truth scale)
reported_overall: count and identity of harmed cells

stage_a_compatibility_gate.family_pass_rule: at least one fixed candidate passes every declared cell and is not globally dominated on all three errors across every cell by any declared control with an equal-or-lower exact-Ag budget; both candidates and every control remain visible
stage_a_compatibility_gate.control_dominance_rule: A declared control globally dominates a candidate only when its exact-Ag A and A-transpose counts are each no greater and its field, gradient, and observation errors are no greater in every declared cell, with at least one strict improvement. Per-cell dominance counts are reported separately but do not alone fail the family.

execution_stages.action: run the frozen 3 scenarios by 5 fit trajectories by 5 frames compatibility matrix and all required stage-A controls

execution_stages.condition: stage A passes the compatibility and control-dominance gates, all bound inputs remain unchanged, and the independent validator reproduces the result
execution_stages.action: expand unchanged candidates and controls to all 101 frames of all five fit trajectories; add Jacobi-PCGLS and validation-selected dual-ridge controls
run adjacent randomized fresh-process resource blocks with setup inside worker, exact and cheap action ledgers, outer wall, worker self RSS, and sampled process-tree RSS
freeze one independent public reaction-flow morphology family before opening it; repeat matched-accuracy first, then resources

pass_requires: Every expected scenario-trajectory-frame-arm cell is present exactly once.
At least one fixed candidate passes every truth-harm and equal-call control gate.
At least one passing candidate is not globally dominated by a declared control with an equal-or-lower exact-Ag budget.
Exact and cheap call ledgers match the frozen counts.
Every bound PoolFire truth and pair identity file has identical pre-run and post-run SHA256.
No validation, stopping-validation, fresh, or test trajectory is opened.
An independent implementation reproduces the factors, metrics, and decision before final PASS.

failure_action: If stage A fails, stop the randomized standalone factor warm route at target scale and compare sparse or streaming exact Ag and geometry-only PCGLS; do not enlarge q, change frames, drop F12, or train a neural rescue.
